title: Fix backend admin principal and force-set admin to uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae

requirements.summary: Add comprehensive console logging to useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook for immediate diagnosis of admin authorization issues
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the browser DevTools console on the live site shows the caller's principal, the hardcoded fallback, the backend isCallerAdmin result, and any error
The hook does not throw unhandled exceptions; errors are caught and logged
Admin status resolves correctly (true) for principal uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae after the backend fix is deployed

file_operations.description: Add detailed console logging throughout the hook to log: (1) the caller's principal text retrieved from identity.getPrincipal().toText(), (2) the hardcoded fallback principal 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae', (3) the raw boolean result returned by the backend actor.isCallerAdmin() call, (4) any errors thrown during the backend call (with error.message and error.stack if available). Wrap the backend call in a try-catch block to ensure errors are logged and do not crash the hook. Log these values at key phases: when starting the check, after the backend call completes, and when transitioning to confirmed/denied/timeout/error states. Use console.group to organize the logs under a 'useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout' label for clarity.
